newsitem.title: USA: Unitog sees Q4 net down.
newsitem.headline: Unitog sees Q4 net down.

text.p: Unitog Co said Thursday it expects fourth quarter net income to be slightly below year ago levels and earnings to be below analysts' estimates.
The company reported net income of $3.0 million in the year ago quarter.
Analysts estimates, according to First Call, are for fourth quarter earnings of $0.38 a share, compared to $0.32 a share a year ago.
The company said revenues in the fourth quarter were $66 million, up $6 million from a year ago.

"Net earnings for the quarter are expected to be below current analysts' estimates due to seven percent less sales in our direct sales business, extra costs associated with the introduction of a new data processing system in our direct sales distribution centers, and slower than expected progress in improving the Michigan rental operations acquired with the Central Quality Services Corporation purchase earlier in the year," chairman Randolph Rolf said.
"We expect net earnings for our fiscal year ended January 26, 1997 to be ahead of the prior year," he said. The company reported net income of $11.5 million, or $1.23 a share a year ago.
